scope: Causal diagnostics of the failed original-source exact-asset experimental shared-arm/palm extension trials. No runtime source, physical capacity, material, collision geometry, clinical limit or acceptance threshold changed during this diagnostic batch.

hypotheses.name: Initial source fit and material orientation
hypotheses.status: Measured representation difference; not proved cause of subsequent drift
hypotheses.finding: Female maximum proximal frame error27.4682deg R_Forearm at0s; male28.0542deg R_Forearm at0s. Wrist/palm positions and orientation remain close. Rendered forearm twist helpers differ less: female proximal7.0?7.6deg/distal2.9?3.5deg; male proximal~9.1deg/distal~4.1deg. After removing recorded global setup floor lift only, forearm skin differs up to9.57mm female/13.02mm male. Native physical frame and deformation-bone frame are not synonymous.

hypotheses.name: Controller motor saturation
hypotheses.status: Demonstrated along achieved trajectory; global static capacity feasibility remains undetermined
hypotheses.finding: Female0.507s R elbow requests?56.21Nm/applies?35Nm, L girdle protraction requests+26.98/applies+12Nm. Male0.5s R elbow requests?71.83/applies?35Nm, L girdle protraction requests+37.11/applies+12Nm. At these states palm feedback terms are fractions of1Nm; posture and gravity-support terms dominate. Exact axes, lever arms, native constraint torques and each motor contribution are retained.

hypotheses.name: Competing task priority
hypotheses.status: Not supported as cause of the early observed drift
hypotheses.finding: Prefix COM controller is tracking, postureScale1, releasedOppositionNm0 at inspected first-drift/first-load-loss states. Saturation clips the combined request. This does not prove global optimal allocation.

hypotheses.name: Contact geometry approximation
hypotheses.status: Measured separate gap; causal effect not isolated
hypotheses.finding: Some actual replay forearm skin is outside validated supporting planes of the native outer forearm cell: up to4.80mm female/7.66mm male setup. Diagnostic rejects ill-conditioned display-triangle normals unless all native mesh vertices satisfy the candidate plane within100nm. Geometry is unchanged; coverage is a conservative plane-excess bound, not nearest-surface distance or clinical tolerance.

hypotheses.name: Integration/contact chatter
hypotheses.status: First single-step loss is timestep sensitive; substantial tracking/slip failure persists
hypotheses.finding: Same initial qpos, source, native sources and settings at1ms versus0.5ms. Female first zero-load shifts~0.51s?0.0235s, and prefix zero-load intervals last one integration step. At0.65s elbow tracking remains21.95/22.98deg female and29.09/28.71deg male. Tangential drift reaches~5.0/6.3mm female and~6.7/8.0mm right male. Full-cycle long losses and7cm drift remain in the earlier A/B.

staticFeasibility.method: Cloned native state, qvel=qacc=0, MuJoCo inverse with discrete-inverse flag; forward/inverse consistency better than1e?9 generalized force. Additional diagnostic fixes bones in a separate model and relaxes the same cells before transferring passive coordinates back only into scratch data.
staticFeasibility.limitation: Fixed-cell inverse is dominated by passive surface and joint-stop disequilibrium. The held-cell transfer changes the contact effective-inertia problem and leaves residual in the original free model. Large reported torques therefore do not establish global actuator infeasibility. No static capacity acceptance is claimed.
staticFeasibility.next: A rigid contact-force equilibrium relaxation may distinguish unavoidable motor capacity from suboptimal allocation, while explicitly including or delimiting self-contact, joint-stop and passive contributions. Feasible relaxation does not qualify the compliant dynamics.

visual.states: Female0,0.507,0.600s; male0,0.040,0.600s. Actual models and all101 rig bones, source/native skin collections, exact native collider overlays.
visual.review: At female0.507s native torso remains lower and elbows more bent than the sparse desired-body source reconstruction. Male0.040s near-start body difference is smaller. Forearm axial-frame residual alone exaggerates visible material twist.
visual.limitation: Intermediate source scenes use the sparse native target interpolant, not the dense5.4s shared-guide playback. This is a diagnostic overlay, not approved source retargeting or clinical review.
